name: motion-light-trail
title: Light Trail
description: Đốm sáng bay theo cung, ba bóng mờ nhoè trễ phía sau cùng một vệt đuôi, gộp lại khi dừng.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Head (r 7 px dot, 12 px glow, 3 px bright core) travels an arc 185 px wide, 34 px high (sine) in 900 ms power2.out; three trailing copies 36 / 72 / 108 ms behind in the demo (recipe: 18 ms steps), opacity 0.45 / 0.30 / 0.18, blur ~1 / 2 / 3 px, radius 6 / 5 / 4, plus a 6 px gradient stroke over the last 90 ms of path; copies merge into the head at rest. Params: duration (0.9 s) · x (185 px) · arc (34 px) · copies (3) · delay (36 ms).
